publisher: San Francisco Bay Conservation and Development Commission
title: San Francisco Bay Plan
source_note: Scanned copy (BCDC scan, 2022) received by email from a private correspondent on 2026-10-26. The plan is printed January 1969; document date is the transmittal letter to the Governor and Legislature, January 6, 1969. The scan also contains Bay Plan Amendments No. 1 and No. 2 (Policy Amendment #1-71, adopted June 3, 1971; Policy Amendment #2, adopted January 4, 1973; 1971 plan map amendments) and Resolution No. 16, Priority Use Areas (transmitted November 30, 1971).
